_comment: Smart tag vocabulary. Groups are scored in order, each as a softmax over its labels (so labels in a group are alternatives); several labels may share a tag (their probabilities add up), and labels with a null tag are distractors that are never stored. A group with 'parents' is only scored when one of those tags was given, so specific kinds sit under broad tags (bird → heron). Prompts are the group's templates with {} replaced by the label's text, averaged. At most maxTags are kept, best first. Attributes are yes/no pairs, optionally with 'parents' too; 'suppresses' drops other groups (a document gets no place or mood). After editing, rebuild src/main/tagging/clip-labels.json with scripts/build-clip-labels.py; libraries re-tag from stored embeddings without rerunning the model.
